The TypeScript package's recorded Stats answers, for the parity test of this
package (tests/test_stats_ts_answers.py).

These files are bca-mcp-ts test/fixtures/stats_api as of its commit 6da48cf
(0.9.0), copied unchanged: answers/, expected_outputs/, shards/, SHA256SUMS
and README.md. 34 of the 53 calls come from the API's dump
(scripts/dump_stats_answers.py at API commit 41b64a2, on the API's
fixtures); the others are stand-ins made before the dump existed. Their
README says which is which and how the expected outputs were made: from the
design's reference rules, not from either package's code. Every wallet and vault address is
made up (0x plus SHA-256 of a bca-fixture string), and no wallet, vault
name or vault figure is from the real files. The yield answers hold the 17
public products of the live Yields file of 2026-11-26, moved to 2026-11-24,
with their token addresses, and four made-up products named Fixture. The six
chain answers (0.9.0) are stand-ins until the API's dump holds chain calls:
the live public Chains file of 2026-11-27, moved to 2026-11-24, whose
incident sources are each chain's own pages.

This package's own set stays in tests/fixtures/stats_api.
